name: OpenSandbox
description: Runs AI-agent workloads in isolated Docker or Kubernetes sandboxes, exposing sandbox lifecycle, command, filesystem, and code-interpreter APIs across five language SDKs.

skills.name: Sandbox Lifecycle Management
skills.description: Creates, times out, and kills container sandboxes from a chosen image through one lifecycle API on Docker or Kubernetes.

skills.name: Code Interpreter
skills.description: Executes Python and other supported languages inside a sandbox and returns the result value, stdout logs, and exit state.

skills.name: Command And File Operations
skills.description: Runs shell commands and reads or writes sandbox files from the SDKs, the osb CLI, or the MCP server used by coding agents.

skills.name: Network Policy Control
skills.description: Routes inbound sandbox traffic through a unified ingress gateway and applies per-sandbox egress rules to restrict outbound calls.

skills.name: Credential Vault Injection
skills.description: Injects credentials into sandbox outbound requests at the proxy layer so workloads never see the real secret values.
